title: Acknowledgment of the Notice of Privacy Practices
about: The patient's acknowledgment that they received the clinic's Notice of Privacy Practices.

source.name: Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment, 45 CFR 164.520(c)(2)(ii)

blocks.text: I have received a copy of the Notice of Privacy Practices of {facility.name}. It explains how my health information may be used and shared, and my rights about it.
For clinic use: if the acknowledgment was not obtained

blocks.label: Reason
items: Emergency treatment; to be obtained later
